description: This cozy mini loft for up to 8 guests, featuring a welcoming mezzanine, is located in Paris’ 8th arrondissement and offers an authentic yet peaceful Parisian atmosphere. Just 500 meters from Saint-Lazare train station, the Moulin Rouge, and Pigalle, it is surrounded by lively bars and restaurants. The loft combines charm and modern comfort, with an open-plan kitchen and an elegant bathroom with a walk-in shower. After a day of exploring the city, perfect for relaxing evenings in Paris.The spaceWelcome to our Mini Loft Dream in the heart of Paris!This modern and bright loft can host up to 8 guests with a comfortable mezzanine and a smartly designed living space.You will enjoy:A cozy living room with a sofa bed and smart TV.A fully equipped kitchen (stove, microwave, Nespresso coffee machine, toaster, kettle, washer/dryer).A modern bathroom with a spacious shower and double sink.Comfortable bedding on the mezzanine, perfect for both short and long stays.Located in a central Parisian neighborhood, close to public transport, restaurants, and main attractions, this loft is perfect to explore Paris while enjoying full comfort.Extras: high-speed Wi-Fi, self check-in, and a warm ambiance combining modernity and Parisian charm.Guest accessGuests have full access to the entire apartment during their stay, including:The living room and fully equipped open kitchenThe private modern bathroomThe mezzanine and all available sleeping areasSelf check-in is available via a secure smart lock, allowing you to settle in at your convenience from 3 PM.
